title: A Registered Design Is Not A Published Result
summary: A map separating design registration, frozen inputs, code and environment identity, authorized execution, blinded outputs, deviations, robustness, replication, claim adjudication, and correction duties.
map_question: What decisions remain between a registered design and a bounded, reproducible, correctable public result?
interpretation_boundary: Design registration, execution authorization, unblinding, deviation review, technical validation, independent replication, claim adjudication, and publication are separate human decisions. A completed run cannot publish itself.

nodes.label: Registered Phase 72 design
nodes.note: No Phase 72 counterfactual design is registered.

nodes.label: Frozen input snapshot
nodes.note: Inputs, versions, checksums, inclusions, exclusions, and lineage are frozen.

nodes.label: Immutable code and environment
nodes.note: Code, dependencies, runtime, plan, estimand, and randomness have exact identities.

nodes.label: Authorized blinded execution
nodes.note: Runner authority, tests, masking, logs, outputs, and receipts are complete.

nodes.label: Blinded output bundle
nodes.note: No Phase 73 output or result exists.

nodes.label: Deviation and amendment review
nodes.note: Ten deviation categories are assessed without treating silence as none.

nodes.label: Robustness and falsification
nodes.note: Sensitivity, null, adverse, placebo, negative-control, and failure results remain visible.

nodes.label: Independent replication
nodes.note: A separately authorized execution records agreements and unresolved differences.

nodes.label: Bounded claim adjudication
nodes.note: Claim class and verb strength are reconsidered after the complete result record.

nodes.label: Correctable public-result lineage
nodes.note: Publication retains visible correction, supersession, and withdrawal duties.

links.note: No frozen input or code bundle exists.
No authorized run or output exists.
An output cannot bypass deviation review.
No deviation, robustness, or falsification record exists.
No result is eligible for adjudication.
No result, claim, correction, or withdrawal exists.

what_this_map_supports: Fourteen execution gates, ten deviation categories, fourteen result-adjudication gates, and eight correction classes.
Visible separation between design registration, execution, unblinding, validation, replication, claim adjudication, and publication.
A fail-closed correction and withdrawal lineage for any future public result.
what_this_map_does_not_prove: It does not establish a registered design, authorized execution, result, effect, replication, attribution, or causal claim.
It does not establish that deviations are absent, assumptions hold, robustness succeeds, or replication agrees.
It does not create a comparison, composite, score, rank, forecast, recommendation, or operating-outcome claim.
next_records_needed: A real Phase 72 design-registration receipt issued before result inspection.
A frozen input, code, environment, plan, log, output, and deviation bundle.
An independently replicated and dual-adjudicated result with correction readiness.
